loe.note: Generics launched August 2023: FDA-approved Lupin tiotropium dry-powder generic of Spiriva HandiHaler; does not establish Respimat entry.
loe.note_zh: 仿制药已于2023年8月上市:FDA批准的Lupin噻托溴铵干粉仿制药,对应Spiriva HandiHaler;不能证明Respimat已有仿制药进入。

loe.note: Generics launched: Adalvo confirms pan-European nintedanib launch on 2026-04-03 following patent expiry. EMA confirms EU generic authorization: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/overview/nintedanib-viatris-epar-medicine-overview_en.pdf .
loe.note_zh: 仿制药已上市:Adalvo确认在专利到期后于2026-04-03在全欧洲上市尼达尼布。EMA确认欧盟仿制药授权:https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/overview/nintedanib-viatris-epar-medicine-overview_en.pdf 。

loe.note: Generics launched in 2026: Sandoz state-filed introduction notice documents US introduction in April 2026; FDA confirms Sandoz ANDA 216915 approval on 2026-04-02: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-and-biologic-approval-and-ind-activity-reports/first-generic-drug-approvals?sub1=FAzQPPTvmBBPr9K7MhJMfp_odthixaOn4Cf&sub2=SL4-WLM&toclid=TO-2nrqdfAxpHGFppjMqWSrjP .
loe.note_zh: 仿制药已于2026年上市:Sandoz向州提交的上市通知文件显示其于2026年4月在美国上市;FDA确认Sandoz的ANDA 216915于2026-04-02获批:https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-and-biologic-approval-and-ind-activity-reports/first-generic-drug-approvals?sub1=FAzQPPTvmBBPr9K7MhJMfp_odthixaOn4Cf&sub2=SL4-WLM&toclid=TO-2nrqdfAxpHGFppjMqWSrjP 。

loe.note: Adalvo announces February 2027 Spanish generic linagliptin launch opportunity after marketing authorization; forward-looking, monotherapy only, not Jentadueto-wide.
loe.note_zh: Adalvo宣布在获得上市许可后,西班牙利格列汀仿制药于2027年2月具备上市机会;属前瞻性信息,仅限单药,不适用于整个Jentadueto。
